evidence.title: GitHub - ExTV/Podroid: A rootless Android app that boots Alpine Linux: run containers (Podman/Docker/LXC) and GUI desktop apps.
Podroid: Linux containers on Android, no root required

name: Podroid
summary: Android app that boots a real Alpine Linux VM to run Podman, Docker and LXC containers and an X11 desktop, no root.
description: Podroid runs a full Alpine Linux VM with its own kernel on an arm64 Android phone — via QEMU, or hardware-accelerated AVF on supported pKVM devices — so containers behave like on a server. Podman, Docker and LXC come pre-installed; an in-app terminal offers xterm-256color, 122 color themes and 13 fonts, an X11 viewer runs GUI Linux apps with touch, keyboard, mouse and audio, and USB passthrough, SSH, port forwarding and a guest-to-Android bridge connect the VM to the phone. Android 8+, English and Chinese.
contains: Alpine Linux VM with a custom kernel via QEMU; AVF on pKVM devices
in-app xterm-256color terminal with 122 color themes and 13 fonts
X11 desktop viewer with touch, keyboard, mouse and audio
USB passthrough, SSH, port forwarding and guest-to-Android bridge
container backup, VM/device status view and Downloads sharing
any arm64 device on Android 8, no root; English and Chinese
